#[path="__FLOAT_SOURCE__"] mod fp;
use keel_ir::{BinaryOp,UnaryOp,Type,FloatCC};
use fp::Float;
fn main(){
    for ty in [Type::F32,Type::F64] {
        let values=if ty==Type::F32 {
            [0u64,0x80000000,0x3fc00000,0xc0200000,0x7f7fffff,1,0x7f800000,0x7fc00000]
        } else {
            [0,0x8000000000000000,0x3ff8000000000000,0xc004000000000000,0x7fefffffffffffff,1,0x7ff0000000000000,0x7ff8000000000000]
        };
        let b=Float{ty,bits:if ty==Type::F32{0x3fa00000}else{0x3ff4000000000000}};
        let c=Float{ty,bits:if ty==Type::F32{0xbf000000}else{0xbfe0000000000000}};
        for bits in values {
            let a=Float{ty,bits};
            for op in [UnaryOp::Fsqrt,UnaryOp::Fceil,UnaryOp::Ffloor,UnaryOp::Ftrunc,UnaryOp::Fnearest] {
                println!("{}",fp::unary(op,a).bits);
            }
            for op in [BinaryOp::Fmin,BinaryOp::Fmax,BinaryOp::Fadd,BinaryOp::Fmul] {
                println!("{}",fp::binary(op,a,b).bits);
            }
            println!("{} {}",fp::fma(a,b,c).bits,fp::compare(FloatCC::Uno,a,b));
        }
    }
}
